summary: PIMCO Corporate & Income Strategy Fund filed an 8-K to disclose a change to its 80% investment policy approved by its Board of Trustees. Effective August 28, 2026, the fund will invest at least 80% of net assets in corporate debt obligations and/or income-producing investments, which may include non-corporate issuers. This is a routine policy update reflected in a supplement to the prospectus and statement of additional information. No transaction, extraordinary corporate event, or structural change is involved. The filing is a standard current report for internal fund policy modifications, not a special situation requiring further analysis or risk-arb angle.
